products.name: Freepik AI
products.note: Stock image AI generation; commercial licensing; EU-hosted; content moderation

reading.body:
Freepik's AI product is a stock image generator with commercial licensing, EU hosting, and content moderation, not a frontier model developer.

The company sits in the application layer of AI. Its differentiator is not compute scale but the licensing and moderation wrapper around generated images, plus EU hosting as a compliance posture. That places it closer to distribution and rights management than to the training runs that consume power.

The data does not include model provenance, compute footprint, data center locations, or energy use. Nothing here supports a claim about Freepik's grid demand or its dependence on any particular accelerator supply. It also does not say which models power the generation or where inference runs beyond the EU hosting note.
